content.short: Royco splits yield sources into senior and junior tranches with differing risk and return.
content.description: Royco divides any yield source into senior, junior and senior LP tranches, so that participants choose where they sit in the loss waterfall rather than all sharing the same exposure. Tranching is standard practice in structured credit and translates cleanly on-chain, where the waterfall can be enforced by contract instead of by documentation.
content.meta: Senior, junior and LP tranches, so participants choose where they sit in the loss waterfall.
